artboards.title: Images › Tilesets, as a list and the chosen one

annotations.text:
DECIDED 2026-09-17: the Sheets section becomes Images, an image library planned for every image kind, tilesets worked through now. Each tileset carries a grid — tile, margin, spacing — with columns and rows derived and anything past the last whole tile ignored.

The layout is the terrain editor's (pass of 2026-09-17): the images down the left, the chosen one big in the middle with its grid drawn on it, the properties beside it as a form. Status is a dot on the row and a reason on the field.

A PNG does not say its tile size. The dialog offers the sizes that divide the image, preselects the density when it fits and otherwise its largest divisor that does, and draws the grid live so a wrong guess is visible before anything is written. Unlisted files in sheets/ come through the same dialog.
DECIDED 2026-09-17: asset pickers are rich typeaheads. The terrain editor's sheet picker is the first one built.
